name: KMUTT International Scholarship Program (KISP)
host: King Mongkut's University of Technology Thonburi (KMUTT)
amount: Tuition + THB 10,000/month (Master's) or THB 8,000/month (Bachelor's) + THB 10,000/year equipment + insurance
dlText: Apply with KMUTT admission (join.kmutt.ac.th); dates per admission round
fields: Engineering, science, technology programmes at KMUTT
note: Full scholarship for international students from countries other than Thailand, Vietnam, Lao PDR, Myanmar and Cambodia (those use the MIS scheme). Applications go through KMUTT's admission system.

name: KMUTT Multi-Intellectual Scholarship (MIS) for CLMV students
host: King Mongkut's University of Technology Thonburi (KMUTT)
dlText: Apply with KMUTT admission (join.kmutt.ac.th); dates per admission round
fields: Engineering, science, technology programmes at KMUTT
note: Full scholarship for bachelor's and master's students from Cambodia, Lao PDR, Myanmar and Vietnam.

name: SIIT Undergraduate Scholarship for Excellent Foreign Students (EFS-U)
host: Sirindhorn International Institute of Technology (SIIT), Thammasat University
amount: 100%, 50% or 25% waiver of tuition and educational support fees each semester
dlText: Per SIIT undergraduate admission round; check official page
note: Merit scholarship for foreign undergraduates in SIIT's English-taught programmes, awarded per admission round; the top tier waives 100% of tuition and educational support fees.

name: VinUniversity Merit Scholarships (President's Excellence / Provost's Merit)
amount: President's Excellence: 100% tuition + living expenses; Provost's Merit: 100% tuition; lower tiers 50–90%
dlText: Several admission rounds per year; check key dates page

eligibility.note: Open to Vietnamese and international applicants; confirm eligibility per round with VinUni admissions

fields: Engineering, computer science, business, health sciences, arts & sciences
note: VinUni's top merit awards cover full tuition (and living costs for the President's Excellence tier); students entering 2025–2030 also get a 35% tuition sponsorship. Keep a GPA of 3.2+ for 100% awards.

name: Fulbright University Vietnam Undergraduate Scholarships & Financial Aid
amount: Merit scholarships 10–100% of tuition for 4 years; need-based aid up to full tuition (+ housing support in years 1–2)
dlText: 26 Jan 2027, 17:00 Vietnam time (Fall cycle, Class of 2031)

eligibility.note: Admission open to Vietnamese and foreign citizens; need-based aid may be limited to Vietnamese nationals — confirm with finaid@fulbright.edu.vn

note: Liberal-arts university in Ho Chi Minh City; scholarships of 10–100% of tuition for the full 4 years are awarded on merit at admission.

name: Darmasiswa Indonesian Scholarship
host: Ministry of Primary and Secondary Education, Indonesia
amount: IDR 4,700,000/month living allowance + one-time settlement (IDR 4.7m) and book (IDR 2m) allowances; tuition-free

eligibility.note: Foreign nationals from countries with diplomatic relations with Indonesia; age limits apply

note: One-year non-degree programme to study Bahasa Indonesia, arts or culture at Indonesian universities, with a monthly living allowance. Apply via the Darmasiswa portal and your Indonesian embassy.
